text:
carmen: heads-up — we started seeing invoice blips for customers using streaming APIs. looks like partial-token events are showing up as separate invoice lines.
rahul: can you paste an example event?
rahul: also is this only for hosted or dedicated as well?
carmen: hosted first. example (redacted):
```json
{"event_type":"stream_chunk","request_id":"r_123","seq":3,"partial_tokens":42,"is_final":false,"model":"gpt-large-v1","route":"chat-completion"}
```
lina: hmm, we've always emitted chunk events as telemetry but billing currently aggregates by event. that will double-count if retries/fire-and-forget happen.
matt: option A: change billing pipeline to accumulate by request_id until is_final=true then emit invoice event. Option B: include dedupe-key (req+seq) and rely on exactly-once ingests.
rahul: A seems safer but means holding state in streaming aggregator. memory concerns for long-lived streams?
carmen: lots of streams finish quickly, but long-poll sessions exist. ops-bot: we can set TTL on partial aggregation keys, e.g., 24h, and emit provisional line if final never arrives.
finance-bot: provisional lines are painful for finance. can we instead mark provisional in console and not materialize invoice until final?
matt: yes — console can show "provisional" while invoices use finalized events. but that requires the metering -> invoicing handoff to respect a finalized flag.
lina: another complication: model tokenization changed in v2 so historical token counts differ. if we backfill/aggregate old chunks with new logic we may shift invoice totals.
carmen: we need to surface a metering_schema_version on events. propose adding `metering_version` to all stream events.
rahul: agreed. that lets us run the aggregator with versioned logic and backfill safely.
ops-bot: rollout plan suggestion:
- shadow-run aggregator for 48h (no invoice emission)
- compare totals per-customer against current pipeline
- enable dedupe+finalization for 5% canary customers for 24h
- increase 25%/50%/100% with monitoring alerts
(we also log a diff file for finance review)
finance-bot: request: when can we provide a reconciliation report? need at least 7 days of shadow diffs before we flip for invoices.
matt: can do. we'll produce daily reconciliation csvs: customer_id, old_total_tokens, new_total_tokens, delta_pct, invoice_risk_flag.
rahul: implementation detail: key for accumulation = `customer_id|request_id|metering_version`. seq used for idempotency. also include `route_tag` to support per-route pricing overrides.
lina: about pricing: route-level price overrides exist in console. finance-bot — if we group streamed chunks into a single final invoice line, should we keep per-chunk route tags or collapse to the route on final event?
finance-bot: collapse to the route on final makes invoices readable. but we need to record the original route(s) in audit logs in case of disputes.
carmen: console UX: add "provisional usage" panes that call out suspected incomplete streams and link to session trace. small bell icon + tooltip.
matt: also we should add schema migration header to the HTTP ingest: `X-Metering-Version: 2` so proxies can inject.
rahul: SQL for the reconciler (rough):
```sql
SELECT customer_id,
  SUM(old_tokens) as old_total,
  SUM(new_tokens) as new_total,
  CASE WHEN SUM(old_tokens)=0 THEN null ELSE (SUM(new_tokens)-SUM(old_tokens))/SUM(old_tokens) END as delta_pct
FROM shadow_diffs
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
ops-bot: action items:
- @matt add metering_version to the stream SDK + proxy (ETA 2d)
- @rahul prototype accumulation store (redis + fallback to rocksdb) (ETA 5d)
- @lina run shadow aggregator job config + diff export (ETA 3d)
- @finance-bot confirm reconciliation fields needed (ETA 1d)
- @carmen wire up provisional UI mock for Console (ETA 4d)
finance-bot: i'll send acceptance criteria and sample report columns. thanks. :thumbsup:
carmen: thanks everyone. i'll open a tracker with the plan and link to this thread.
